title: Legal & Acceptable Use
intro: reverseshell is built for authorized security professionals. Read these policies before generating or running any command.

trust_summary.title: Trust & safety at a glance
trust_summary.body: Commands are generated locally in your browser. reverseshell does not execute payloads, open callbacks, or upload your lab data to our servers.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.body: reverseshell is provided for educational purposes, authorized security testing, bug bounty programs, CTF competitions, and security research only. You must have explicit written permission before testing any system you do not own.

acceptableUse.title: Acceptable Use Policy
items: Only use reverseshell against systems you own or have explicit authorization to test.
Do not use generated commands for malicious attacks, harassment, or unauthorized access.
You are solely responsible for compliance with applicable laws and regulations.
reverseshell does not execute payloads or open callbacks — you control where commands are used.

prohibited.title: Prohibited use
items: Using generated output for fraud, extortion, or disruption.
Attempting to bypass laws, regulations, or program rules.

does_not_do.title: What reverseshell does not do
items: Execute payloads or open network callbacks on your behalf.
Upload your commands, collections, or lab notes to our servers.
Provide exploits, initial access, or target discovery.
Replace written authorization or legal review for your engagement.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: Command generation and collections are stored locally in your browser. No payload data is sent to our servers.
